full_judgment: 3. The facts relevant for disposal of the case are that the predecessor-interest of appellant Nos.1-5 and appellant No.6 as plaintiffs instituted Title Suit No.75 of 1996 in the First Court of the Assistant Judge, Chandina, Comilla for declaration that the judgment and order dated 06.01.1988 passed in Miscellaneous Pre-emption Case No.82 of 1985 was collusive, fraudulent, void and not binding upon the plaintiffs and also for partition stating, inter alia, that one Imam Ali was the owner of the land covering an area of 1.565 acres as described in the schedule of the plaint. Thereafter, the same was devolved upon one Delani, who sold the same to Dhirendra Nath Datta, Gobinda Chandra Saha, Zitendra Kumer Bhadra, Sunity Sudha Bhadra, Atindra Natrh Bhadra and others. Babu Dhirendra Nath Datta and others instituted Partition Suit No.64 of 1950 in the First. Court of the then Subordinate Judge, Comilla and got decree. They got saham in respect of the land described in schedule-2 to the plaint which is the subject matter of Title Suit No.75 of 1996. Zatindra Mohon and Sunity Sudha Bhadra sold .1150 acre land to defendant No.1, Bazlur Rahman Chowdhury and one Mominul Hoque. Mominul Hogue gifted his share to his father-in-law, Rowshan Ali on 15.04.1981. Rowshan Ali gifted the same to plaintiff No.1 by a deed dated 01.02.1984. Plaintiff No.1, while possessing .08 acre land, transferred .04 acre land to his wife, plaintiff No.2 by a Hiba-bil-Ewaz deed dated 11.03.1984. By this way, the plaintiffs acquired title in .0575 acre of land. They came to know that defendant No.1 had managed to get an order of pre-emption in Preemption Case No.82 of 1985 on the basis of solenama which was fraudulent one. The plaintiffs requested the defendants to effect partition of the land of the disputed Khatian but in vain; hence the suit.
